analyst_view.overall: Early view: Olympiacos (6th, 10 points) have conceded once in four league-phase games and are second in the Greek league. Celje (25th, 4 points) beat Sturm Graz 3-2 last time and should have Artemijus Tutyskinas back after his ban is served at Ferencvaros; they could need points here to stay in the top 24.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean a little lower: Olympiacos's European games have produced five goals in four, and they have conceded only four in nine Greek league games. Celje's games have been open (3.5 goals a game), but they scored nothing at Leverkusen or at home to Omonia, and Olympiacos are as hard to break down as anyone in the competition.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, with Olympiacos expected to win most of them. Celje like to attack at home, so they should add a few of their own, which fits the site's total.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. Neither side's European games have been heated so far, so I stay with the number until the referee is named.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.0 shots. Olympiacos tend to control games without piling up shots, while Celje will try to take the game to them, so I stay close to the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Olympiacos's defence has allowed very little, and their own attack has been economical (four goals in four games), so I'd expect fewer clear chances than usual.
